text:
June: Quick kick 1 - Stellar Systems customer story. They finished the pilot and are open to a short case + livestream demo. Need quote + signed release before we publish.

Priya: Awesome. Their PMs prefer Tues or Thu next week for a 20-min interview. Which day should we lock?

Sam (Sales): Tue is better for the handoff to SDRs. We want to route inbound demo requests to their account execs immediately after publish.

June: Ok locking Tue 11am PT. @Luca (Stellar) can you confirm? Also we need the hero quote and approval on the metric language (they reported 3.7x throughput uplift).

Luca (Stellar): Tue 11am PT works. We can confirm the 3.7x number and share the performance spreadsheet under NDA. We'll sign the release after legal checks.

Ethan (Legal): Send the exact quote text and attach the spreadsheet. We'll need a release with a data-source line and the option for a 7-day embargo if they request it. Also include the standard attribution clause.

Priya: Draft hero quote: "With Redwood, we achieved a 3.7x throughput improvement and halved per-request cost on our streaming inference pipeline." Thoughts?

Ethan (Legal): Two notes: 'halved' is concrete. Either provide the baseline and timeframe or switch to 'approximately 50%'. Also include where measurement happened (prod vs. staging).

Luca (Stellar): Measurements were on a prod-like staging environment over a 14-day run. We'll drop the spreadsheet into a shared folder. Prefer 'approximately 50%' in the public quote.

June: Updated hero: "With Redwood, we achieved a 3.7x throughput improvement and approximately 50% lower per-request cost." I'll send for sign-off after the release form is signed.

docs-bot: Release templates: https://drive.redwood/release-templates/customer-release-v3.pdf 

Ethan (Legal): I've uploaded a redline with GDPR opt-out language and a data-source sentence: "Benchmark results measured on a 14-day staging run; data provided by Stellar Systems." Link: https://legal.redwood/redlines/2957612345

Priya: Thanks. @Luca please sign the release doc and drop the spreadsheet link by EOD so we can publish next Wednesday.

Luca (Stellar): Signing now. Spreadsheet link: https://share.stellar/benchmarks/redwood-pilot-14d.xlsx (access granted).

Sam (Sales): When publish is live, please create an SFDC campaign and add a webhook to route demo interest to AE team. I can own the campaign setup.

June: Noted. I'll create a pre-publish checklist: 1) Signed release, 2) Asset approvals (hero + bullets), 3) SFDC campaign created, 4) Social copy.

Priya: I'll draft the short blog + 3-tweet thread and post a copy-approval thread tomorrow AM. Expect 2 rounds max.

Ethan (Legal): All good on legal once the signed release is attached. Leaving a small redline asking to remove 'customer logos may be used in marketing collateral' unless they check the box.

Luca (Stellar): Ok to use logos. Signing completed and uploaded (see legal folder). Looking forward to the call on Tue.

June: Great. Final action items: Priya will post draft, Sam will prep SFDC campaign, June will schedule recording and publish window, Ethan will close redline. If all done, target publish Wed next week.

Sam (Sales): I'll add the AE routing rule and tag the campaign to the Stellar account. Will confirm when done.

Priya: Draft thread incoming tomorrow 9am PT.

Ethan (Legal): Closing thread after I mark redline resolved. :white_check_mark:
